description: Resume a paused run after its external stage was answered (submit_stage does this for you), or a run its spending limit stopped (a paid run asks the person for a new, higher total; max_usd is the figure suggested). Completed stages replay from disk and cost nothing.

max_usd.description: the figure to suggest as the run's new total, a positive number. A paid run its limit stopped asks the person for the new total in the dialog; this figure is only the suggestion. For a chain with no paid seat it raises the ceiling for the rest of this run, and "none" removes it. "none" is refused where the user set COUNCIL_MAX_USD_LIMIT; a figure above that limit is refused; 0 is refused.

name: resume_run
